description: Angular component for the home page of the application, managing UI interactions, responsive layout, search functionality, and fullscreen toggling.

classes.name: HomeComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for the application's home page, handling layout, search, fullscreen, and component state.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes layout based on viewport size and sets up breakpoint observer.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions on component destruction.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets up search input value change handling with debounce and distinct checks.

methods.name: sidenavClicked
methods.description: Toggles the sidenav if in 'over' mode.

methods.name: toggleFullscreen
methods.description: Toggles fullscreen mode using screenfull library.

methods.name: isFullscreen
methods.description: Returns whether the application is in fullscreen mode.

methods.name: activeComponentChanged
methods.description: Updates the active component and related UI state.

methods.name: updateActiveComponent
methods.description: Updates UI based on the new active component, including search and loading bar visibility.

methods.name: displaySearchMode
methods.description: Returns whether search mode should be displayed.

methods.name: closeSearch
methods.description: Deactivates search input and resets search text.

methods.name: searchTextUpdated
methods.description: Handles updates to search text and propagates to searchable component.
